title: Fourth moment of a centered affine transform
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with a probability distribution $P$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ have mean zero and third moment zero. For any $d,e\in\mathbb{R}$, the fourth moment of $dX+e$ is $d^4\mathbb{E}[X^4]+6d^2e^2\mathbb{E}[X^2]+e^4$.
